description: This file contains test cases for a FastAPI application, specifically testing query parameter validation with regex constraints, and the generation of the OpenAPI schema. It uses pytest and FastAPI's TestClient to perform HTTP requests and validate responses.

methods.name: get_client()
methods.description: Creates a FastAPI app with an endpoint that expects a regex-constrained query parameter and returns a test client.

methods.name: test_query_params_str_validations_no_query()
methods.description: Tests that the endpoint returns 'Hello World' when no query parameter is provided.

methods.name: test_query_params_str_validations_q_fixedquery()
methods.description: Tests that the endpoint returns 'Hello fixedquery' when the query parameter matches the regex pattern.

methods.name: test_query_params_str_validations_item_query_nonregexquery()
methods.description: Tests that the endpoint returns a 422 validation error when the query parameter does not match the regex pattern.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema()
methods.description: Validates that the generated OpenAPI schema accurately reflects the endpoint's parameter constraints and responses.

methods.name: read_items( q: Annotated[str | None, Query(regex="^fixedquery$")] = None, )
